definitions.Twn: (Tw - 250) / 50, Tw the vapor-path-weighted temperature from the top to the layer middle
definitions.dp: layer thickness, hPa (p_half below minus p_half above)
definitions.lP: ln(max(Pw, 1e-3)), Pw the vapor-path-weighted pressure from the top to the layer middle (hPa)
definitions.lUs: ln(max(U_mid, u_floor) * sec(zenith)), U_mid the vapor path from the top of the atmosphere to the layer middle
definitions.lu_dn: lu of the layer below (the bottom layer repeats its own)
definitions.lu_up: lu of the layer above (the top layer repeats its own)

reference.case: GDAS 2026-09-01 18Z analysis on the T255 grid (step-0 checkpoint), both-clear blocks of the GOES-19 18:00Z full disk (rw_goes colocate, 24-pixel blocks), zenith <= 70
reference.driver: tools/crtm_reference/abi_crtm_reference.f90 (K-matrix, clear sky, no aerosol, no cloud, US-standard ozone fill, climatology by latitude and season above the model top)

goes19_spccoeff.note: SpcCoeff only, no TauCoeff; not used by the reference runs

reference.model: CRTM v3.1.1 (JCSDA CRTMv3, tag v3.1.1, commit bd262087acbd49866fac557444a3ab2bba9169b1), built with gfortran 15.2.0 and netCDF-Fortran 4.6.2 on Linux x86-64, OpenMP on, run single-threaded
reference.optical_depth_convention: CRTM RTSolution%Layer_Optical_Depth is the NADIR layer optical depth of the user layers (the layers CRTM adds above the model top are not included); the emission solver applies sec(zenith); reproduced to 0.005 K (band 13) and 0.033 K rms (band 8) by the plain emission march
reference.sensor_coefficients: abi_g16 SpcCoeff + ODPS TauCoeff (GOES-16 ABI, the closest public set; GOES-19 has a SpcCoeff but no TauCoeff), IR water Nalli, IR land IGBP table
